verdict.rationale: NetHunt documents customizable pipelines and stages: users can modify stages, create new pipelines, move stages via automation triggers, and bulk-update a record's stage. Nothing in the evidence describes a visual board/kanban view or drag-and-drop stage updates, so only the customizable-stages half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented visual pipeline/board view, drag-and-drop deal movement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: Modify fields, pipeline stages, views, and automations to match your unique processes.
Customize existing pipelines and create new ones to get valuable insights into your sales process.
Adjust stages of the pipeline based on any trigger event.
Update multiple records' fields: stage, status, priority, manager.
